children.text: Orchid Monitor median alert latency is 42 ms.
Cedar Monitor median alert latency is 58 ms.

root_proposition.text: Orchid Monitor has a lower median alert latency than Cedar Monitor because Orchid is 42 ms and Cedar is 58 ms.

sources.content: The performance table reports Orchid Monitor median alert latency of 42 ms.
The same benchmark reports Cedar Monitor median alert latency of 58 ms.
Orchid Monitor startup latency was 420 ms after a cold boot.
Cedar Monitor documentation lists a 58 MB installer package.
Alert routing supports email and webhook delivery.
